tools.name: projectinsight_list_active_projects
tools.description: List every active project in the workspace. Good first call to see what is in progress. Project Insight API: GET /api/project/active.

tools.name: projectinsight_search_projects
tools.description: Search projects by text, customer, project number, or active/planning state. Project Insight API: GET /api/project/search.

tools.name: projectinsight_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Project Insight API: GET /api/project/list?ids={id}.

tools.name: projectinsight_list_project_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one project, including the default task properties unless modelProperties is set. Project Insight API: GET /api/task/project/{projectId}.

tools.name: projectinsight_search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks by keyword, project, or whether they belong to active projects. Project Insight API: GET /api/task/search.

tools.name: projectinsight_create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in the given item container. This writes a new record each call and is not idempotent. Project Insight API: POST /api/project.
